title: Conventional heavy gathering: Lloydminster, Hardisty, Cold Lake and the northern feeders
dek: Conventional heavy oil reaches market through a small set of named gathering systems converging on two hubs. Husky Midstream (Cenovus-operated) gathers the Lloydminster heavy country, feeds its own upgrader, blends Western Canadian Select, and runs onward to Hardisty. Inter Pipeline's Cold Lake system (1,200 kb/d) splits to Edmonton and Hardisty, its Bow River system gathers SE Alberta into Hardisty with a segregated take-or-pay leg south to Milk River, and its Mid-Saskatchewan system shares the Kerrobert Mainline door with Plains' Manito heavy system and its diluent loop. Pembina's Nipisi and Mitsue pair is the northern heavy and diluent corridor into Edmonton. How Peace River heavy oil is tendered today is an open item and is printed as one.
